definition: People who have been killed or injured in a war.
examples: Casualties are people who have been killed or injured in a war.

definition: People who are forced to leave their country or home because there is a war, or for political or religious reasons.
examples: Refugees are people who are forced to leave their country or home because there is a war.

definition: A group of people who have been trained to protect others, usually with weapons, e.g. armed forces, security forces, peace-keeping forces.
examples: Forces are a group of people who have been trained to protect others, usually with weapons.

definition: Soldiers in large groups.
examples: Troops are soldiers in large groups.

definition: An officer in charge of a military operation.
examples: A commander is an officer in charge of a military operation.

definition: People who have been injured by weapons.
examples: The wounded are people who have been injured by weapons.

definition: People who are not in the army, navy, or airforce.
examples: Civilians are people who are not in the army, navy, or airforce.

definition: People who shoot at others from a hidden position.
examples: Snipers are people who shoot at others from a hidden position.

definition: People who have managed to stay alive in a war.
examples: Survivors are people who have managed to stay alive in a war.

definition: In time of war, a country that has agreed to help and support another country.
examples: An ally is in time of war, a country that has agreed to help and support another country.

definition: An attempt by some of the people in a country to change their government, using violence.
examples: A rebellion is an attempt by some of the people in a country to change their government, using violence.

definition: A sudden change of government that is illegal and often violent.
examples: A coup is a sudden change of government that is illegal and often violent.

definition: When two armies agree to stop fighting temporarily.
examples: A ceasefire is when two armies agree to stop fighting temporarily.

definition: When an army tries to take a city or building by surrounding it and stopping the food supply.
examples: A siege is when an army tries to take a city or building by surrounding it and stopping the food supply.

definition: A war between groups of people in the same country.
examples: A civil war is a war between groups of people in the same country.

definition: A formal agreement between two or more countries.
examples: A treaty is a formal agreement between two or more countries.

definition: An attempt by a large number of people in a country to change their government.
examples: A revolution is an attempt by a large number of people in a country to change their government.

definition: To remove a government or leader from power using force.
examples: The rebels overthrew the government.

definition: To start suddenly, usually used for wars, fighting, or fires.
examples: Fighting broke out between the rebels and the army.
The fire broke out at 3.00 in the morning.

definition: To fire missiles at a position.
examples: The army shelled the rebel positions.

definition: To move back, away from the opposing army.
examples: The rebels retreated.
The flood water took a long time to retreat from the streets.

definition: To admit that you have lost and want to stop fighting.
examples: Some of the rebels surrendered.
The minister was arrested and forced to surrender his passport.

definition: To make something explode.
examples: The rebels blew up the airport runway.

definition: To announce an intention to go to war.
examples: The government declared war on the rebels.
He declared that he was in love with her.

definition: To steal things from shops and buildings during a war or riot.
examples: Some rebels looted the city.

definition: To take someone prisoner or to catch something.
examples: The army captured over 300 rebels.
The new princess has captured the imagination of the public.

definition: To beat someone in a fight, war, or competition.
examples: They finally defeated the rebels.
I read the instructions three times, but they completely defeated me.

definition: To let someone go or make something public.
examples: The army released most of the rebel prisoners.
The police have released details of the accident.

definition: To kill someone as a punishment.
examples: They executed the rebel leader.
